# omics-skills 1.6.1

Version 1.6.1 is a correctness and streamlining release. It fixes defects that
made skills report confident wrong answers, removes the `jgi-lakehouse` skill,
and reduces the repository to one installer. The package contains four agents
and 34 skills for Claude Code and Codex.

## Correctness

- `bio-annotation` and `bio-protein-clustering-pangenome` called a gene family
  query-specific whenever the reference *median* copy number was zero. With
  reference counts `[0, 0, 1]` the family is present in a reference, so the
  driver reported a discovery with an infinite fold change that did not exist.
  Query-specific now requires absence from every reference; the median-zero case
  is reported as `present_in_reference_minority` with no fold change.
- `bio-annotation` rejected any protein carrying two family hits. Multi-domain
  proteins are the normal case; uniqueness is now per protein and family, and a
  protein identifier must still belong to exactly one genome. Protein counts
  count proteins, not annotation rows.
- `bio-assembly-qc` always passed `--nano-hq` to Flye, assembling PacBio CLR
  reads under the wrong error model. The sample sheet gains a required
  `read_platform` column for long-read modes.
- `bio-reads-qc-mapping` reported `planned` in `mapping_stats.tsv` even after
  `--execute`, and advertised a `coverage.tsv` no stage produced.
- `public-db-lookup` echoed an API key supplied through `--path` back into the
  emitted URL, and never redacted successful response bodies. Credential-named
  parameters are now refused wherever they are supplied, secrets are redacted
  before and after JSON decoding, and repeated parameters such as Entrez
  `id=` survive.
- `csag-extraction` strict mode accepted impossible character offsets and quotes
  that appear nowhere in the source. It now checks offsets and compares
  `exact_text` against the document, and requires `--source-markdown`.
- `ai-scientist-evaluator` kept a "publication-ready" recommendation beside a
  failed hard gate. Publication readiness is now derived from the gates.
- `biorxiv-search` reported success with zero results when the API returned an
  error status, and the documented `OR` example matched neither alternative.
- `public-db-lookup` and `biorxiv-search` no longer turn an HTTP 200 error
  envelope into a confident empty result.
- `install_hook.py` appended a second `codex_hooks` key when one was already
  set to `false`, which made the user's whole `~/.codex/config.toml`
  unparseable. It now edits the existing key, preserves inline comments, and
  refuses to write anything `tomllib` cannot parse or that does not take effect.
- The router leaked skills a pinned agent does not own into its dependency
  expansion, and suppressed every skill for any prompt naming a repository. Both
  paths now apply the agent filter and distinguish a scientific subject from a
  software one.
- CI's shell syntax gate checked only the first script in its batch, and skipped
  `validation/` entirely.
- `collect_slurm_evidence.py` ran an unqualified `sacct -j`; job IDs collide
  between clusters. It now passes the manifest cluster to `sacct -M` and records
  it in the run evidence (`schema_version` 1.1).
- `make validate` checked three hand-picked skills and required both runtimes;
  it now checks every agent and skill and skips absent runtimes.
- `make clean` cleared a backup location the installer no longer uses.
- Ten skills carried a quality gate reading "On failure: retry with alternative
  parameters", sitting among biological thresholds. It now separates execution
  failure from unmet biological thresholds, which are results, not retry
  triggers.

## Removals

- `jgi-lakehouse` is removed. A JGI-specific query is now an intentional
  no-match rather than silently routing elsewhere, and `make install` retires
  any installed copy.
- `scripts/install.sh`, `scripts/uninstall.sh`, `scripts/install_tui.py`, and
  `scripts/test-install.sh` are removed. The Makefile is the single installer;
  it dropped from 657 to 363 lines. The shell installer had diverged: it
  replaced an existing `~/.claude/skills` directory with a symlink, hiding every
  skill inside. Both `make install` and the Makefile now refuse that instead.
  `make test` runs the validators the smoke script used to run.
- `plotly-dashboard-skill` merged seven uppercase root documents into
  `references/style.md` and `references/architecture.md`, 729 lines down to 381.
- The tooling-baseline table lives only in `docs/tooling-survey-2026.md`; the
  README copy had already drifted.

## Upgrade

Run `make install` after updating. It removes the retired `jgi-lakehouse`
entry, rebuilds the catalog, and re-renders the Codex agents. `make uninstall`
replaces `make uninstall-all` and now also removes the routing hook.

Installation from a checkout needs GNU Make and Python 3.11 or newer.
